messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed both issues: only fewer moves replace a size’s best, and unfinished sizes show `Best: none`. Added size-switch and reload regression checks.

Typecheck, build, and 140 unit tests passed. All 77 browser checks passed across runs; two initially timed out, and artwork required a temporary longer limit.

Edited files pass formatting. The full formatting check still flags 17 unchanged files.
